editorial_decisions.decision: The pizza introduction explicitly says two equal halves as an example, rather than implying any two unequal pieces make halves. All model wholes are the same size and each partition uses equal parts. This makes the model's implicit condition explicit without changing its arithmetic.
Source Algebraically introduces arithmetic notation with no variables. Use গাণিতিক চিহ্নে so the phrase describes the actual notation without an unnecessary claim of variable algebra.

Retain the dollar and quarter context and the original $1 tokens. Explain the unfamiliar coin and parking-payment device in Bengali; do not substitute local currency or claim present-day machine acceptance beyond the source hypothetical. One dollar plus one quarter is five quarters; removing three leaves two quarters, or half a dollar.

Read regrouped image notation such as 1 beside 4/4 or 5/5 as a whole plus a fraction, not multiplication and not a new normalized mixed-fraction definition. The total before subtraction is still two wholes.

The full-circle-plus-separate-quarter model first totals 5/4. Removing the separate quarter and the right half of the whole leaves the left half, exactly 2/4=1/2. Bengali table prose and alternative text describe these actual stages.
